items_flat.title_en: Altman and Amodei brief UN Security Council on AI risk
items_flat.title_zh: Altman與Amodei向聯合國安理會簡報AI風險
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei addressed a UN Security Council session on AI during UNGA week. Altman, in person, called for international standards on measuring capabilities, assessing risks, checking safeguards and keeping human oversight; Amodei, by video, warned AI could become a risk to humanity and proposed narrow bans such as on biological weapons, plus verification and incident notification.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI執行長Sam Altman與Anthropic執行長Dario Amodei在聯大週於聯合國安理會AI場次發言。Altman親赴現場，呼籲就能力衡量、風險評估、防護是否足夠與人類監督建立國際標準；Amodei視訊出席，警告AI可能成為對人類整體的風險，並提出禁止用於生物武器等有限協議，以及驗證與資安事件通報。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is the highest-profile political forum the two labs have shared this week, but it is testimony, not a treaty. Whether the Council or member states turn the asks into measurable evaluation or verification regimes remains unconfirmed.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是兩家實驗室本週層級最高的政治場合，但仍是證詞而非條約。安理會或會員國會否把訴求落成可驗證的評估與查核機制，目前尚未證實。
items_flat.quote: AI can either be more like a new renaissance of creativity and discovery, or more like a new industrial revolution of upheaval and disarray.
items_flat.quote_zh: AI要麼更像一場創造與發現的新文藝復興，要麼更像一場動盪失序的新工業革命。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI extends Daybreak cyber access to Ukraine
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI將Daybreak網路防禦開放給烏克蘭
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI announced it will give Ukraine’s government access to its Daybreak program to help defend civilian infrastructure, working with the Ministry of Digital Transformation. Daybreak is for authorized security work such as reviewing legacy software, investigating suspicious activity, validating vulnerabilities and testing fixes. The announcement was made on the sidelines of UNGA by Ukraine’s consul general in San Francisco and OpenAI’s head of national security policy.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI宣布將向烏克蘭政府提供Daybreak計畫，與數位轉型部合作協助防護民用基礎設施。Daybreak用於授權資安工作，包括檢視舊系統、調查異常、驗證漏洞與測試修補。宣布於聯大週邊由烏克蘭駐舊金山總領事與OpenAI國家安全政策主管共同發表。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a policy deployment of frontier cyber tools, not a new model launch. Independent reporting says access includes GPT-5.6 Sol and is framed as free support; the official post does not detail model names, audit rights or offensive-use limits.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是前線資安工具的政策部署，不是新模型發表。獨立報導稱包含GPT-5.6 Sol且以免費支援呈現；官方文未細列模型名稱、稽核權或攻擊用途限制。
items_flat.quote: OpenAI today announced it will offer the Government of Ukraine access to its Daybreak program to support the cyber defense of civilian infrastructure.
items_flat.quote_zh: OpenAI今日宣布將向烏克蘭政府提供Daybreak計畫，以支援民用基礎設施的網路防禦。

items_flat.title_en: Google launches Gemini 3.8 Flash and Flash-Lite TTS
items_flat.summary_en: Google introduced Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS for custom voice design and line-by-line direction, and Gemini 3.8 Flash-Lite TTS for high-volume, lower-cost speech. Both support 100+ languages, a large prebuilt voice library, long-form and two-speaker audio, and sit in the Gemini Audio line after 3.8 Live. Google says Flash TTS leads Hume AI’s Voice Design Benchmark at 71.4.
items_flat.summary_zh: Google推出Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS，強調自訂音色與逐句導演；以及面向大量、低成本語音的Gemini 3.8 Flash-Lite TTS。兩者支援百種以上語言、大量預建音色、長篇與雙人對白，接續3.8 Live所在的Gemini Audio產品線。Google稱Flash TTS在Hume AI Voice Design基準以71.4居首。
items_flat.analysis_en: This extends Gemini Audio after Live models, competing on controllable production speech rather than a new text flagship. Voice replication is geo-restricted, so availability and rights rules will decide real studio uptake.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是Live之後的Gemini Audio延伸，競爭點在可控的製作級語音，而非新的文字旗艦。聲音複製有地區限制，實際工作室採用取決於可用範圍與權利規則。
items_flat.quote: Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS and Gemini 3.8 Flash-Lite TTS are our most expressive audio generation models yet.
items_flat.quote_zh: Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS與Gemini 3.8 Flash-Lite TTS是我們迄今最具表現力的音訊生成模型。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic says Claude discovered a CRISPR-like phage enzyme system
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic稱Claude發現類CRISPR噬菌體酶系統
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic introduced a new in-house life-sciences lab and said Claude agents, given a high-level prompt, found array-associated reverse transcriptases (ART) in jumbo-phage DNA—an uncharacterized RT plus a partner gene and CRISPR-like repeats. About 950 agents used 210 million tokens over 21 hours before a human-reviewed lab follow-up. Anthropic says ART’s function is still unknown.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic公布內部生命科學實驗室，並稱Claude代理在高層提示下，於巨型噬菌體DNA中發現陣列相關反轉錄酶（ART）——未充分描述的RT、伴隨基因與類CRISPR重複序列。約950個代理在21小時內使用2.1億token，再經科學家複核與實驗。Anthropic表示ART功能仍未知。
items_flat.analysis_en: The claim is agent-led genome mining plus human validation, not a proven gene-editing tool. Anthropic itself says ART’s job is unknown; independent labs still need to reproduce the find and show programmable cutting or writing.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 主張是代理主導的基因組探勘加上人類驗證，並非已證實的基因編輯工具。Anthropic自己也說ART用途未知；仍需獨立實驗室重現，並證明可編程切割或寫入。
items_flat.quote: Claude has discovered a previously unknown enzyme system hidden in the DNA of bacteriophages.
items_flat.quote_zh: Claude在噬菌體DNA中發現先前未知的酶系統。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI releases open MentalHealthBench with 80+ clinicians
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI公開MentalHealthBench，逾80名臨床專家參與
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI published MentalHealthBench, an open evaluation of 1,215 synthetic mental-health conversations co-created with more than 80 licensed experts in 22 countries. It scores safety, context-seeking, user agency and guidance across non-acute to crisis scenarios, including teens, adults, caregivers and clinicians. OpenAI says other researchers can inspect methods and rerun the set.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI發布開放基準MentalHealthBench，含1,215段合成心理健康對話，由22國逾80名持證專家共同制定。評分涵蓋安全、尋求脈絡、使用者自主與指導，場景從非急性到危機，涵蓋青少年、成人、照顧者與臨床人員。OpenAI表示其他研究者可檢視方法並自行重跑。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a measurement and safety product, not a therapy feature. Scores are OpenAI-run with an automated grader; other labs can now rerun the open set, which is the main check on whether the published rankings hold.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是評測與安全產品，不是治療功能。分數由OpenAI以自動評分器跑出；其他實驗室現在可重跑開放題組，這才是檢驗排名是否站得住的主要方式。
items_flat.quote: We’re releasing it openly so other researchers can examine the methods, run their own evaluations, and build on the work.
items_flat.quote_zh: 我們公開發布，以便其他研究者檢驗方法、自行評估，並在此基礎上繼續推進。

items_flat.title_en: Amazon opens seller tools to Claude and Quick agents
items_flat.title_zh: Amazon將賣家工具開放給Claude與Quick代理
items_flat.summary_en: Amazon said Seller Assistant now keeps persistent memory and can run always-on workflows for restocking, pricing and alerts, still on Bedrock with Claude. A Selling Partner plugin launches in Amazon Quick and in beta with Anthropic’s Claude, so sellers can query inventory and approve write-actions without leaving the assistant. U.S. sellers get the beta first; primary account holders can claim 12 months of Quick Plus through year-end.
items_flat.summary_zh: Amazon表示Seller Assistant現具持久記憶，並可常駐執行補貨、定價與警示工作流，仍跑在Bedrock上的Claude。Selling Partner外掛登陸Amazon Quick，並與Anthropic Claude進入測試，賣家可查庫存並核准寫入動作。美國賣家先測；主帳號可領至年底的12個月Quick Plus。
items_flat.analysis_en: The story is Amazon’s distribution of Claude into merchant operations, not a new Anthropic model. The gap to watch is whether approved write-actions stay inside Amazon’s data boundary and audit trail in production.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 重點是Amazon把Claude鋪進賣家營運，不是Anthropic發表新模型。需觀察獲准的寫入動作在正式環境是否仍落在Amazon資料邊界與稽核軌跡內。
items_flat.quote: A new plugin brings Seller Assistant’s intelligence into the AI tools sellers already use, launching first with Amazon Quick and in beta with Anthropic's Claude.
items_flat.quote_zh: 新外掛把Seller Assistant的能力帶進賣家既有AI工具，先登陸Amazon Quick，並與Anthropic的Claude進入測試。

items_flat.title_en: ChatGPT Voice adds plugins and GPT-6 models
items_flat.title_zh: ChatGPT Voice加入外掛並可接GPT-6模型
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI said ChatGPT Voice can now use plugins such as email, calendar and Slack; be powered by GPT-6 Astra, Sol and Luna; and run inside ChatGPT Work on web and mobile for spoken document, deck and spreadsheet work. The company said the change is rolling out globally in the latest app version.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI表示ChatGPT Voice現可使用電子郵件、行事曆與Slack等外掛；可由GPT-6 Astra、Sol與Luna驅動；並在網頁與行動版ChatGPT Work以語音處理文件、簡報與試算表。公司稱此改動隨最新App全球推出。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a product wiring change, not a new voice model. The practical limit is whether Live-mode plugin actions stay reliable under full-duplex talk, which OpenAI has not published as a measured success rate.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是產品接線，不是新語音模型。實際瓶頸是全雙工對話下外掛動作是否穩定，OpenAI尚未公布可核對的成功率。
items_flat.quote: ChatGPT Voice can now: Use plugins like your email, calendar, and Slack. Be powered by GPT-6 Astra, Sol, and Luna. Be used in ChatGPT Work on web and mobile.
items_flat.quote_zh: ChatGPT Voice現在可以：使用電子郵件、行事曆與Slack等外掛；由GPT-6 Astra、Sol與Luna驅動；在網頁與行動版ChatGPT Work中使用。

items_flat.title_en: Musk says Grok Bot usage is accelerating; weekly feature drop
items_flat.title_zh: 馬斯克稱Grok Bot用量加速；產品週更
items_flat.summary_en: Elon Musk wrote that “Grok @Bot usage is growing faster than anything we’ve ever seen,” quoting Bloomberg coverage that SpaceXAI staff presented 418,000 weekly users in the week ending September 14, up 24% week on week. He separately amplified product-team posts on weekly Grok Bot feature drops. No new xAI model card accompanied the posts in this window.
items_flat.summary_zh: Elon Musk寫道「Grok Bot用量成長快過我們見過的任何東西」，並引用彭博對SpaceXAI內部簡報的報導：截至9月14日當週週活躍約41.8萬、週增24%。他另轉發產品團隊的Grok Bot週更。此窗口沒有伴隨新的xAI模型卡。
items_flat.analysis_en: These are executive and product-team posts, not an xAI model card. The 418k figure is from a staff presentation reported by Bloomberg, not an audited xAI metrics release.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是高階與產品團隊發文，不是xAI模型卡。41.8萬來自彭博所報的內部簡報，並非經稽核的xAI指標發布。
items_flat.quote: Grok @Bot usage is growing faster than anything we’ve ever seen.
items_flat.quote_zh: Grok Bot用量成長快過我們見過的任何東西。

items_flat.title_en: Anthropic says health groups use Claude on a DRC Ebola outbreak
items_flat.title_zh: Anthropic稱衛生組織以Claude應對剛果（金）伊波拉疫情
items_flat.summary_en: Anthropic published a feature saying CEPI, WHO AFRO and INRB in Kinshasa are using Claude to speed work on an unusual Ebola variant in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo. The company framed it as applied outbreak support, not a new model.
items_flat.summary_zh: Anthropic發布專文，稱CEPI、WHO非洲區與金夏沙INRB正用Claude加速應對剛果民主共和國東部一株不尋常伊波拉變異。公司定位為疫情應用支援，而非新模型。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is a customer-story post. Independent clinical outcomes, data-handling terms and how much the model changed response time are not in the announcement.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是客戶故事。獨立臨床結果、資料處理條件，以及模型實際縮短多少應變時間，公告中未提供。
items_flat.quote: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, global health organizations including CEPI, WHO AFRO, and INRB are using Claude to accelerate their response to an outbreak of an unusual Ebola variant.
items_flat.quote_zh: 在剛果民主共和國，包括CEPI、WHO非洲區與INRB在內的全球衛生組織正使用Claude加速應對一株不尋常伊波拉變異疫情。

items_flat.title_en: OpenAI and Grab launch GO Forward with AI for 30,000 partners
items_flat.title_zh: OpenAI與Grab推出GO Forward with AI，目標3萬名夥伴
items_flat.summary_en: OpenAI and Grab launched a two-year regional program to teach practical AI skills to 30,000 Grab driver, delivery and merchant partners. It started in Singapore on September 23 and is slated for Thailand, Indonesia and the Philippines later in 2026, then Malaysia and Vietnam in 2027. Workshops introduce ChatGPT Work; Singapore participants also get three months of ChatGPT Plus after the class.
items_flat.summary_zh: OpenAI與Grab推出兩年區域計畫，要讓3萬名Grab司機、外送與商家夥伴學會實用AI技能。9月23日先在新加坡開課，2026年稍後擴至泰國、印尼與菲律賓，2027年到馬來西亞與越南。工作坊介紹ChatGPT Work；新加坡學員課後另獲三個月ChatGPT Plus。
items_flat.analysis_en: This is distribution and skilling, not a model release. Impact depends on completion rates and whether workshop use converts into lasting paid or work-tool usage.
items_flat.analysis_zh: 這是通路與培力，不是模型發表。成效取決於完課率，以及工作坊使用會否轉成持續付費或工作工具使用。
items_flat.quote: Over the next two years, the programme will help 30,000 of Grab’s driver-, delivery-, and merchant-partners across Southeast Asia build skills they can use in their work and businesses.
items_flat.quote_zh: 未來兩年，計畫將協助東南亞3萬名Grab司機、外送與商家夥伴培養可用於工作與經營的技能。

anthropic.summary_zh: Anthropic公布內部生命科學實驗室，並稱Claude代理在高層提示下，於巨型噬菌體DNA中發現陣列相關反轉錄酶（ART）——未充分描述的RT、伴隨基因與類CRISPR重複序列。約950個代理在21小時內使用2.1億token，再經科學家複核與實驗。Anthropic表示ART功能仍未知。
anthropic.analysis_en: The claim is agent-led genome mining plus human validation, not a proven gene-editing tool. Anthropic itself says ART’s job is unknown; independent labs still need to reproduce the find and show programmable cutting or writing.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 主張是代理主導的基因組探勘加上人類驗證，並非已證實的基因編輯工具。Anthropic自己也說ART用途未知；仍需獨立實驗室重現，並證明可編程切割或寫入。
anthropic.quote: Claude has discovered a previously unknown enzyme system hidden in the DNA of bacteriophages.
anthropic.quote_zh: Claude在噬菌體DNA中發現先前未知的酶系統。

anthropic.title_en: Amazon opens seller tools to Claude and Quick agents
anthropic.title_zh: Amazon將賣家工具開放給Claude與Quick代理
anthropic.summary_en: Amazon said Seller Assistant now keeps persistent memory and can run always-on workflows for restocking, pricing and alerts, still on Bedrock with Claude. A Selling Partner plugin launches in Amazon Quick and in beta with Anthropic’s Claude, so sellers can query inventory and approve write-actions without leaving the assistant. U.S. sellers get the beta first; primary account holders can claim 12 months of Quick Plus through year-end.
anthropic.summary_zh: Amazon表示Seller Assistant現具持久記憶，並可常駐執行補貨、定價與警示工作流，仍跑在Bedrock上的Claude。Selling Partner外掛登陸Amazon Quick，並與Anthropic Claude進入測試，賣家可查庫存並核准寫入動作。美國賣家先測；主帳號可領至年底的12個月Quick Plus。
anthropic.analysis_en: The story is Amazon’s distribution of Claude into merchant operations, not a new Anthropic model. The gap to watch is whether approved write-actions stay inside Amazon’s data boundary and audit trail in production.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 重點是Amazon把Claude鋪進賣家營運，不是Anthropic發表新模型。需觀察獲准的寫入動作在正式環境是否仍落在Amazon資料邊界與稽核軌跡內。
anthropic.quote: A new plugin brings Seller Assistant’s intelligence into the AI tools sellers already use, launching first with Amazon Quick and in beta with Anthropic's Claude.
anthropic.quote_zh: 新外掛把Seller Assistant的能力帶進賣家既有AI工具，先登陸Amazon Quick，並與Anthropic的Claude進入測試。

anthropic.title_en: Anthropic says health groups use Claude on a DRC Ebola outbreak
anthropic.title_zh: Anthropic稱衛生組織以Claude應對剛果（金）伊波拉疫情
anthropic.summary_en: Anthropic published a feature saying CEPI, WHO AFRO and INRB in Kinshasa are using Claude to speed work on an unusual Ebola variant in eastern Democratic Republic of the Congo. The company framed it as applied outbreak support, not a new model.
anthropic.summary_zh: Anthropic發布專文，稱CEPI、WHO非洲區與金夏沙INRB正用Claude加速應對剛果民主共和國東部一株不尋常伊波拉變異。公司定位為疫情應用支援，而非新模型。
anthropic.analysis_en: This is a customer-story post. Independent clinical outcomes, data-handling terms and how much the model changed response time are not in the announcement.
anthropic.analysis_zh: 這是客戶故事。獨立臨床結果、資料處理條件，以及模型實際縮短多少應變時間，公告中未提供。
anthropic.quote: In the Democratic Republic of the Congo, global health organizations including CEPI, WHO AFRO, and INRB are using Claude to accelerate their response to an outbreak of an unusual Ebola variant.
anthropic.quote_zh: 在剛果民主共和國，包括CEPI、WHO非洲區與INRB在內的全球衛生組織正使用Claude加速應對一株不尋常伊波拉變異疫情。

google.title_en: Google launches Gemini 3.8 Flash and Flash-Lite TTS
google.summary_en: Google introduced Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS for custom voice design and line-by-line direction, and Gemini 3.8 Flash-Lite TTS for high-volume, lower-cost speech. Both support 100+ languages, a large prebuilt voice library, long-form and two-speaker audio, and sit in the Gemini Audio line after 3.8 Live. Google says Flash TTS leads Hume AI’s Voice Design Benchmark at 71.4.
google.summary_zh: Google推出Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS，強調自訂音色與逐句導演；以及面向大量、低成本語音的Gemini 3.8 Flash-Lite TTS。兩者支援百種以上語言、大量預建音色、長篇與雙人對白，接續3.8 Live所在的Gemini Audio產品線。Google稱Flash TTS在Hume AI Voice Design基準以71.4居首。
google.analysis_en: This extends Gemini Audio after Live models, competing on controllable production speech rather than a new text flagship. Voice replication is geo-restricted, so availability and rights rules will decide real studio uptake.
google.analysis_zh: 這是Live之後的Gemini Audio延伸，競爭點在可控的製作級語音，而非新的文字旗艦。聲音複製有地區限制，實際工作室採用取決於可用範圍與權利規則。
google.quote: Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS and Gemini 3.8 Flash-Lite TTS are our most expressive audio generation models yet.
google.quote_zh: Gemini 3.8 Flash TTS與Gemini 3.8 Flash-Lite TTS是我們迄今最具表現力的音訊生成模型。

xai.title_en: Musk says Grok Bot usage is accelerating; weekly feature drop
xai.title_zh: 馬斯克稱Grok Bot用量加速；產品週更
xai.summary_en: Elon Musk wrote that “Grok @Bot usage is growing faster than anything we’ve ever seen,” quoting Bloomberg coverage that SpaceXAI staff presented 418,000 weekly users in the week ending September 14, up 24% week on week. He separately amplified product-team posts on weekly Grok Bot feature drops. No new xAI model card accompanied the posts in this window.
xai.summary_zh: Elon Musk寫道「Grok Bot用量成長快過我們見過的任何東西」，並引用彭博對SpaceXAI內部簡報的報導：截至9月14日當週週活躍約41.8萬、週增24%。他另轉發產品團隊的Grok Bot週更。此窗口沒有伴隨新的xAI模型卡。
xai.analysis_en: These are executive and product-team posts, not an xAI model card. The 418k figure is from a staff presentation reported by Bloomberg, not an audited xAI metrics release.
xai.analysis_zh: 這是高階與產品團隊發文，不是xAI模型卡。41.8萬來自彭博所報的內部簡報，並非經稽核的xAI指標發布。
xai.quote: Grok @Bot usage is growing faster than anything we’ve ever seen.
xai.quote_zh: Grok Bot用量成長快過我們見過的任何東西。

frontier_other.title_en: Altman and Amodei brief UN Security Council on AI risk
frontier_other.title_zh: Altman與Amodei向聯合國安理會簡報AI風險
frontier_other.summary_en: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman and Anthropic CEO Dario Amodei addressed a UN Security Council session on AI during UNGA week. Altman, in person, called for international standards on measuring capabilities, assessing risks, checking safeguards and keeping human oversight; Amodei, by video, warned AI could become a risk to humanity and proposed narrow bans such as on biological weapons, plus verification and incident notification.
frontier_other.summary_zh: OpenAI執行長Sam Altman與Anthropic執行長Dario Amodei在聯大週於聯合國安理會AI場次發言。Altman親赴現場，呼籲就能力衡量、風險評估、防護是否足夠與人類監督建立國際標準；Amodei視訊出席，警告AI可能成為對人類整體的風險，並提出禁止用於生物武器等有限協議，以及驗證與資安事件通報。
frontier_other.analysis_en: This is the highest-profile political forum the two labs have shared this week, but it is testimony, not a treaty. Whether the Council or member states turn the asks into measurable evaluation or verification regimes remains unconfirmed.
frontier_other.analysis_zh: 這是兩家實驗室本週層級最高的政治場合，但仍是證詞而非條約。安理會或會員國會否把訴求落成可驗證的評估與查核機制，目前尚未證實。
frontier_other.quote: AI can either be more like a new renaissance of creativity and discovery, or more like a new industrial revolution of upheaval and disarray.
frontier_other.quote_zh: AI要麼更像一場創造與發現的新文藝復興，要麼更像一場動盪失序的新工業革命。

brief_en: Altman and Amodei briefed the UN Security Council on AI risk and global standards. OpenAI extended Daybreak to Ukraine and opened MentalHealthBench; Google shipped Gemini 3.8 TTS; Anthropic said Claude found a CRISPR-like phage enzyme. Amazon wired Claude into seller tools.
brief_zh: Altman與Amodei在安理會談AI風險與全球標準。OpenAI將Daybreak給烏克蘭並公開MentalHealthBench；Google推出Gemini 3.8 TTS；Anthropic稱Claude發現類CRISPR噬菌體酶系統。Amazon把Claude接入賣家工具。
